problem_context.expected_behavior: Return the number of data nodes reachable from linklist->node_next; the supplied sentinel/root node itself is not counted and the list is preserved.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Own xizi_sll_head(linklist,l), require Zlength(l) <= UINT_MAX, return Zlength(l), and restore the same xizi_sll_head(linklist,l).
spec_hint: Use the LOS-style high-level rooted-list view xizi_sll_head at the public boundary. If traversal needs the first successor address, quantify it only inside the loop invariant together with head-field ownership, prefix segment, and remaining suffix.
preferred_hidden_properties: l splits into a traversed prefix l1 and remaining suffix l2; length = Zlength(l1), while the root next field and xizi_sllseg(first,tmp,l1) * xizi_sll(tmp,l2) preserve the whole head view.
forbidden_patterns: Do not count the sentinel head; do not expose a concrete first pointer in the public With; do not mirror traversal as a new Rocq algorithm.
